sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Laboratory"."ID" AS e, "Patient"."SEX" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "Laboratory" JOIN "Patient" ON "Patient"."ID" = "Laboratory"."ID"  GROUP BY "Laboratory"."ID", "Patient"."SEX"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: share of the all total of number of Laboratory records (all level)
rank within the group by number of Laboratory records, keep the top 3
